hypothesis: Conditional short funding receipts may be offset by settlement-window trade-price movement and round-trip execution costs; compare a fixed nearby non-settlement window.
funding: q times fixed strictly-pre-event completed mark proxy times observed raw rate as fraction, positive receipt for SHORT; retrospective conditional attribution, not an available trading forecast
mark_reference: Use the CLOSE value of the minute mark bar whose OPEN timestamp is T-2min. Its raw close endpoint is T-1min-1ms and logical availability T-1min, strictly before T. Fixed conservative charge-mark proxy, not exact original latest-eligible-mark selection or actual venue charge mark.
clock_policy: every observed funding timestamp must exactly equal a fixed UTC slot, exactly one event per asset per slot, otherwise STOP; no silent shift/drop
boundary_policy: exclude only pairs missing required source minutes outside 2023; expected five Jan1 00h asset pairs; report all exclusions
selection: all assets and slots, no funding-sign, return, month or asset filter; no parameter/window sweep
arithmetic: base quantity q=1/entry_OPEN; sell_fill=entry_OPEN*(1-8bp); cover_fill=exit_OPEN*(1+8bp); fee=5.5bp*q*(sell_fill+cover_fill); price=q*(entry_OPEN-exit_OPEN); execution=q*8bp*(entry_OPEN+exit_OPEN); net=price+funding-execution-fee
primary_reporting: one-USDT reference PnL in basis points, calendar-day equal-weight mean event net and paired event-minus-control net; pooled sample means separately

uncertainty.method: circular moving-block bootstrap over joint calendar-day means
uncertainty.scope: descriptive conditional seen2023 dependence sensitivity; not selection-corrected causal inference

outputs: all five assets, all12 months, full-year component means,365 daily joint means, full exclusion list, cost allowance, sample counts and source/code hashes
limitations: No shared-wallet replay or executable strategy return
Minute OPENs are retrospective references, not quotes or proven fills
Nearby controls do not identify a causal funding effect
No2026 values, no new market download or model fitting
No annualized NAV, liquidation result or profitable-month selection
One-USDT normalization is an attribution unit, not a min-notional-compliant executable order
